summary: Phase 5 of plan v5 implemented: proved flo_oldlabel_transport (the shared old-label reflection lemma, 'the mathematical crux') fully sorry-free and axiom-clean. Documented deviation from the plan's anticipated proof shape: Task 5.1 expected a well-founded/rank induction using FLO-2's edge-locality bound to avoid the naive-swap collision the Postmortem Constraints flag (swapFn's involution also relocates the old label's own structure onto the fresh witness). Closer analysis found a simpler sufficient construction -- a one-directional (non-involutive) relabeling substFn a b (a maps to b, identity everywhere else, in particular fixing b) never touches b's own incident edges at all, avoiding the collision by construction (satisfying the task's own stated requirement) via a different construction than anticipated. The only freshness fact used is y0 not in the ambient graph's domain (already part of the theorem's fixed Phase-1 signature); FLO/rankOf/FLO-2 are not needed by the proof, so the well-founded induction of Task 5.1 and the separate assembly of Task 5.2 both turned out to be unnecessary -- flo_oldlabel_transport's single conclusion already covers every y' (fresh or old, dwitness-shaped or not) uniformly in one shot; NIK.freshWitness_transport is the special case where y' also happens to be fresh. Landed the reusable general lemma NIK.relabelFresh (mirrors NIK.swap_relabel's case shape, ~150 lines) plus substFn/substFn_self/substFn_other/List.map_substFn_eq_self, all sorry-free and axiom-clean. lake env lean on the probe is clean: exit 0, zero errors, sorry count unchanged at 4 (the pre-existing deriv_reflect/dwitness_mem_of_maximal/flo_succ/primeC'_exists_maximal strategic sorries from Phases 2-4, all preserved verbatim, none newly introduced). --lit re-read of chunk_0102.md/chunk_0103.md confirmed no further textual guidance beyond what prior phases already extracted (the fresh-vs-old label distinction is an artifact of this development's cofinite-quantifier Lean encoding, not present in Simpson's informal proof). Zero-debt invariant holds: zero Cslib/ mainline files touched; Phases 1-4's landed assets (Stage/FloTask/stepExt/FloSeq/rankOf/FLO, FloSeq.mono, flo_succ, flo_limit, flo_succ_fair/flo_holds_everywhere/primeC'_exists_maximal) and Phase 3/4's NIK.swap_relabel/NIK.freshWitness_transport/NIK.diaWitness_transport were not edited -- the new machinery is additive. Plan v5 Phase 5 heading updated to [COMPLETED] with both checklist items (5.1, 5.2) annotated as deviations plus the --lit task marked done. Committed as 'task 517 phase 5: prove flo_oldlabel_transport (shared old-label reflection lemma)'.
